positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Java and Python development of GUI applications.
  - Qt, PyQt, Swing
  - OpenStreetMap, Mapnik, mod_tile

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: EMAC Apps specializes in developing killer iPhone and iPad apps!

positions.title: Associate - Java Developer
positions.description:
Extended application functionality to support new SMTP interface
 - Lead design deiscussions
 - Researched new technologies
 - Implemented designs in Java using mime4j and storm
Supported customer site installation of system 
 - system was deployed on 26 virtual machines in 3 different domains
 - full system was deployed and available for customer use within 30 day window
Created a complex test harness that allowed for rapid creation of test cases to perform full range of automated functional, performance, and stability testing
 - functional tests were created using Selenium Grid with java and junit testing
 - performance and stability tests were created with SoapUI using Groovy

positions.title: Release Engineer
positions.description: During this 3 month contract I tested and upgraded the Perforce server for the development team to the latest version.  Migrated JIRA, Confluence, Crowd, FishEye, and Crucible to a new server and upgraded them to the latest version.  After the migration and upgrade JIRA, Confluence, Bamboo, FishEye, and Crucible were migrated from SQL Server to Oracle 11g.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description: While with WU Studios I managed a 9 person engineering team in Beijing, China remotely creating task lists, mile stone plans, and weekly schedules.  Created detailed technical design documents from system designs and implemented code policies for integration, release versioning, and quality assurance verification.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working with 5 artists and designers I created the character creation process for Warhammer Online: Age of Reckoning.  While managing a 3 person team I lead the graphical user interface (GUI) refresh project on Dark Age of Camelot.

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description: Contributed to the successful development of the multi award winning Sid Meier's Civilization 4.  Developed a data driven XML game data system, World Builder interface, user interface widgets and windows, debugged and play tested interface code for Python to C++ game code.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created plugin software for microscope cameras used in the medical imaging software Image-Pro.  Created installation packages and customized versions of Image-Pro for OEM customers.

positions.title: Mark III File Systems Engineer
positions.description: I maintained a proprietary macro assembly mainframe system.

positions.title: Private First Class
positions.description: Some of my duty assignments were 8th & I security detail, Presidential Guard, and 3rd Battalion 2nd Marines.
